benefits_health_001.evidence: All teachers under contract shall be eligible for the group insurance programs provided by the board.

benefits_health_employee_premium_003.evidence: Medical insurance premiums paid by the employee reflect a percentage of the total of medical insurance and are recalibrated annually.

benefits_dependent_health_004.evidence: Insurance coverage (medical, life, etc.) for eligible contract teachers cannot begin until the Benefits Personnel Office receives completed online enrollment confirmation and, if necessary, supporting documentation (marriage certificate, dependent birth certificate, etc.).

benefits_dental_006.evidence: Teachers who retire early under the provisions and timelines of the Early Retirement Incentive Program for Teachers may continue to enroll in the District’s group medical and dental programs for five consecutive years...
